title: CohortFlow：具备局部语义修正的可引导临床队列筛选智能体
summary: CohortFlow 将自然语言修正转化为对结构化队列规范的局部更新，并与持久化执行图协调，通过记录语义依赖实现选择性失效，在保持需求级准确率的同时将修正延迟降低 64.8%、模型调用减少 38.1%。
summary_en: CohortFlow represents natural-language corrections as localized updates to a structured cohort specification reconciled with a persistent execution graph; recorded semantic dependencies enable selective invalidation, cutting correction latency by 64.8% and model calls by 38.1% while maintaining requirement-level accuracy.
